name: How does fiber cement siding compare to vinyl siding?

mainEntity.name: How does fiber cement siding compare to vinyl siding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fiber cement siding offers superior durability, fire resistance, and a more robust appearance compared to vinyl siding. It is less prone to melting, cracking from extreme temperature changes, or fading over time. While vinyl is generally a lower-cost initial investment and quicker to install, fiber cement provides better protection against pests and offers a higher return on investment due to its longevity and aesthetic appeal. Fiber cement also allows for custom paint colors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fiber cement is more durable, fire-resistant, and aesthetically versatile than vinyl, offering better long-term protection and appearance.
